    • getDefaultValue

      public static Value getDefaultValue(Types type, int decimals)
      Returns the default value of a type, used when a column has no explicit default value:
      • BOOLEAN: false.
      • DECIMAL: zero with the given number of decimals, e.g. 0.00 for 2.
      • DOUBLE, INTEGER, LONG: zero.
      • STRING: an empty string.
      • DATE, TIME, DATETIME, BINARY, OBJECT: a null value of the type.
      Numbers and booleans never default to null, so that they can be defined as NOT NULL. The nullable types default to null; for BINARY and OBJECT, normally stored as BLOB and CLOB, this avoids initializing large objects that have no content. A new value is returned on each call, so it can be modified freely.
      Parameters:
      type - The type.
      decimals - The number of decimals, used only for DECIMAL. Zero or negative means no decimals.
      Returns:
      The default value.
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - If the type is null.
